༄༅/bla ma yid bzhin nor bu las/gcod yul lam khyer bsdus pa gsang gtor phung po bdud rtsi kun khyab bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu las/ gcod yul lam khyer bsdus pa gsang gtor phung po bdud rtsi kun khyab bzhugs so//

ting 'dzin 'bum phrag du ma'i sgo// 'byed mkhan bsam gtan rdo rjer 'dud// gsang gtor phung po mchod sbyin gyi// ngag 'don rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bstan// de yang gter gzhung las/ gsum pa gsang ba'i gtor ma ni: dang po bla mar mos gus bskyed: rang sems bla ma zhi bar bsgom: ces pa nas/ ngal dub gsol ba snying nas btab: ces gsungs pas/ rang sems ma bcos tha mal gyi ngang nas bla ma dbyer med phyir/ de nas khyad par du bla ma blos bsgom mi dgos te/ rang nyid tha mal gyi spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan yid bzhin nor bu wal gyis gsal la mos gus tshad med kyi shugs bskyed cing tshig don dran pa'i ngang nas/ phaṭ: rang tha mal gyi spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng*// rigs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma rje// bdag mos gus kyi gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phyi lha 'dre yi snyems thag sems su chod// nang gnyis 'dzin gyi mdud pa rang sar grol// blo dgos med kyi rten 'brel rgyud la 'char// lus gces 'dzin gyi chags zhen 'khri ba chod// sems chos sku ru grol bar byin gyis rlobs// phaṭḥ tshe thog med nas da bar 'khor ba'i tshe// lus sha khrag gi skye 'jig grangs med kyang*// de mchod sbyin du ma song chud zos pas// da bdag 'dzin gyi phung po tshogs su btang*// phaṭ phaṭḥ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab cing bdag gzhan gnyis 'dzin gyi 'khri ba bcad do// phaṭḥ snying padma 'dab brgyad gyes pa'i steng*// rang rig 'di gser gyi rdo rje'i tshul// rgya sran de tsam zhig 'phar la khad// rtsa dbu ma khong seng zang thal gyi// lam 'gags med har sang spyi bor zug /phaṭaḥ rlung sems dbyer med kyi sgras bskul bas// yar tshangs bug nas thogs med mda' ltar 'phang*// pha bla ma'i thugs dang gnyis med bsres// phaṭ phaṭ: phaṭḥ gzugs phung de bem por lings kyis song*| /rang rig dang bla ma dbyer med kyi// thugs ka nas 'od zer 'bru gsum 'phros// phung khams la phog pas ltem gyi zhu// phaṭḥ

bcud zag med kyi bdud rtsi mdangs dang ldan// gzugs sgra dang dri ro reg bya chos// gang 'dod 'byung phun sum tshogs pa'i rdzas// yongs srid gsum 'jig rten khyab par gyur// phaṭ phaṭḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phaṭḥ bdag gces spras kyis bskyang ba'i phung po 'di// blo zhen bral gyi mchod sbyin rdzas su btang*// bcud 'dod yon phun tshogs nam mkha'i mdzod// yid tshogs drug lha mo'i sgyu 'phrul gyi// rtsal 'gags med rol pa'i mchod sbyin 'di// zhing rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas// rigs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma 'byung*// khyed brgyud bcas kyi bla ma thams cad la// bdag gces 'dzin gyi phung po tshogs su 'bul// rgyud smin grol gyi byin chen dbab tu gsol/ phaṭ phaṭḥ lha yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang*// tshogs phyi nang gi 'du ba kun spyod pa'i// ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// dbyings ye shes dang 'jig rten kun rol ba'i// dpal chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho bcas// khyed mchod yul gyi skyabs gnas thams cad la// bdag gces 'dzin gyi phung po tshogs su 'bul// nyams bde stong gi rtogs pa sbar du gsol/ phaṭḥ rten 'brel gyi 'char sgo 'gag med las// sku gsum gyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i bcud// 'bru gsum gyi nus pas 'phro 'du yis// gzugs phung kun myong grol gyi bdud rtsir gyur/ phaṭḥ snang yul gyi zhing khams kun khyab pa'i// zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// phyi rigs kyi dpal mgon nor lha'i tshogs// dkar phyogs kyi gzhi bdag yongs la bsngo/ phaṭḥ sngags ting 'dzin gyi spro bsdu'i rol pa las// gzugs sha rus kyi phung po ri ltar nyil// bcud khrag zhag gi bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil// 'di snang srid kyi lha 'dre yongs la bsngo/ phaṭ phaṭḥ gang 'dod kyi longs spyod der snang ba'i// rdzas sna tshogs su 'byung ba sgyu ma'i 'phrul// 'di rigs drug gi sems can thams cad dang*// bgegs lan chags kyi bdag po rnams la bsngo/

phaṭ phaṭḥ lus sha khrag gi bdud rtsi'i lhag ma 'di// mgron glo bur du lhags pa'i 'byung po dang*// khas zhan dang dbang chung gi rigs rnams la// gang ci 'dod bzhin bsngos pas tshim gyur cig /phaṭ phaṭḥ sbyin yul du gyur pa snying rje'i mgron// rnam smin gyi rang gzugs 'dre gdon rnams// sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba kun zhi nas// sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob gyur cig /phaṭ phaṭḥ phyi snod dang nang bcud kyi sems can zhes// dngos snang kun sgyu ma ru khro lo lo// lhar snang dang 'drer 'dzin gyi gnyis rtog kun// stong nyid kyi klong du ro gcig 'dres/ phaṭ phaṭḥ bsngo bya dang bsngo byed kyi mkhan po sogs// dmigs med kyi ngang du dbye bsal bral// mchod yul dang sbyin gnas kyi mgron rigs rnams// rang rig gi rtsal snang las gzhan ma grub/ phaṭ phaṭḥ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes sbyong tshogs// spro bsdu dang bral ba rig pa'i gshis// gnyis chos kun gdod nas chos sku'i klong*// spang blang gi mtha' grol e ma ho/ phaṭ phaṭḥ slar stong nyid kyi rang mdangs sgyu ma'i 'phrul// tshogs gnyis kyi dge tshogs gang mchis pa// mkha' khyab kyi sems can yongs la bsngo// rnam mkhyen gyi 'bras bu thob par shog /phaṭ phaṭḥ ces bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab nas mthar stong gsal chos sku'i rang mdangs ma 'gags par khyab brdal du bzhag go /gsang gtor phung po mchod sbyin la brtson pa'i phan yon gter gzhung las/ lus kyi dngos 'dzin zhen pa chod: sgrib sbyong tshogs rdzogs bar chad zhi: bdag gzhan bla med don gnyis 'grub: phung po mchod sbyin tshogs kyi mchog: gsang gtor 'di nyid brtson pa yi: tshe rabs skye ba thams cad du: las can skyes bu stobs dang ldan: phung po tshogs mchod gsang gtor zab: ces gsungs so: de ltar gtor ma phyi nang gsang gsum gyi ngag 'don gter gzhung gi dgongs don ltar bkod pa 'di ni 7gong ma rigs bdag dam pa'i bka' yi gnang ba thob pa la brten nas phyogs bcu pa bsam gtan bstan 'dzin gyis spu bo kaḥganam chos rgyal chen po'i pho brang du zin bris su bgyis pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad thar pa dang rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob par gyur cig
